name: Trigger Public File Sync
description: Manually trigger the Drive→GCS sync for the public file service. This is a lightweight 1-step process that just hits the sync-service /sync-all endpoint and verifies the sync completed. Use this when a user wants to sync files, NOT p-sync-health-check (which is a multi-step health check).
narrative: Force an immediate Drive→storage sync for the public-file service instead of waiting for the next scheduled run. Hit the sync service's sync-all trigger, then verify the sync completed cleanly before reporting done. A lightweight nudge for when freshness cannot wait for the poll.
